title: MA61013: Foundations Of Computer Science
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: voidGraph theory and algorithms, Search techniques, Dynamic
programming, Backtracking. Propositional logic, Predicate logic, Automated
theorem proving, Functional and logic programming, Proof of program
correctness. Finite state automata, Regular expression, Grammar, Turing
machine, Recursively enumerable sets, Computibility. Relational data base,
SQL, Relational calculus, Functional dependency, Normal forms, File
organization, Index sequential file. Computer networks: Interconnection
schemes, Digital signal encoding, Addressing schemes, Transmission media.
Operating systems: Process scheduling, Disk scheduling, Deadlocks, File
structure on UNIX, inode, Concurrent programming, Critical section problem.
Artificial Intelligence: Natural language processing , Knowledge
representation, expert systems, Default reasoning, Production systems. Compiler
design: Syntax directed translation, Lexical analysis, Code generation, DAG
representation, Loop optimization, Data flow analysis.
